# Big Beautiful Flop

> Making presidential statements presidential again.

An independent satirical project. Original statements are sourced and attributed. All presidential and regional adaptations are fictional, AI-assisted editorial interpretations.

Each article quotes one public statement by Donald Trump verbatim, with its date and source, then offers satirical adaptations: a "presidential" version and regional versions (French-speaking Switzerland, France), each with an English adaptation. Only the original statement is a quotation; every adaptation is fictional and must never be attributed to Donald Trump.

## Articles

- [Hopefully, they will show all the good things](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/sixty-minutes-tonight/): The President will be on “60 Minutes” tonight, and hopes the programme will show everything good done in two years, and asks the Republican Senate for help.
- [Send them directly to me](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/send-them-directly-to-me/): Threats against Republican donors are illegal, the President says: report them to the Department of Justice, or directly to him. A real president, and six regions, reply.
- [A Press Secretary like none other](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/dana-white-press-secretary/): The head of the UFC is offered the White House podium, with champion fighters as assistants, to defend the administration against the Lunatic Left.
- [Extortion at the highest level](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/extortion-at-the-highest-level/): Democrats are threatening officials with impeachment and donors with prison, without reason, the President says; he orders the Department of Justice to look into it.
- [A new Chief of Staff](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/stephen-miller-chief-of-staff/): Stephen Miller becomes Chief of Staff on Monday; Susie Wiles moves to the political operation, with thanks.
- [Nobody wants to say that](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/iran-nuclear-middle-east/): Without him, the President writes, Israel and the entire Middle East would not exist today. Nobody wants to say it; everybody knows it.
- [Joe will never let you down](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/joe-gruters-rnc/): A Complete and Total Endorsement for the RNC Chairman, who once named the President Statesman of the Year. Twice.
- [Super Intelligence is GOLD](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/super-intelligence-gold/): The President is 100% in favour of Super Intelligence, and of the states that get rich from it; those that say no are foolish. Twenty-two regions and four statesmen reply.
- [Newsmax says so](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/newsmax-winner/): Early morning: the President shares a headline that calls him a winner. A real president would have let it go.
- [We would have won in a landslide](https://bigbeautifulflop.com/statements/landslide-not-on-the-ballot/): On the evening of the midterm elections, the President points out that he was not on the ballot, and says that if he had been, he would have won in a landslide.
